Six typography sets for psyctl

Every render below came from the production renderer on the same two slides: System Note (THINK, blue_black palette) and Build Log (BUILD palette), at 1080×1350. Click any image to zoom. The proposed assignment and the three open questions are at the bottom.

Proposed assignment (identities/psyctl/visual-system.yaml)

Open questions

  1. Should Field Note (photographic series) follow the System Note serif, or stay on inter_editorial since its cards mostly carry a photo with a short caption? Compare serif_display vs inter_editorial above.
  2. Should garamond_intellectual replace serif_display for System Note when the body is long (carousel slides), or should the two serifs coexist by format? Garamond's body sits smaller at the same size — favors short texts.
  3. Should Weekly and Monthly Control share one set (plex_technical) so the CONTROL loops look alike?
